summary: Convert implementation units -> display units (J/mol -> J/g etc. using phase molar masses).

summary: Protocol: may appear in the numerator of a Jansson derivative.

summary: Temperature (K). v.T['degC'] gives display in Celsius.

summary: Pressure (Pa); usual condition v.P: 101325.

name: Y (site fraction)
summary: Site fraction v.Y('BCC_B2', sublattice_index, 'AL'); string 'Y(BCC_B2,0,AL)'.

name: Species
summary: Chemical species (name, constituents, charge); .weight.

name: Component
summary: Component (pure element or linear combination).

name: Model.G
summary: Gibbs energy per formula unit (J) (alias formulaenergy).

name: Model.HM
summary: Molar enthalpy (alias enthalpy).

name: Model.H
summary: Enthalpy per formula unit (alias formulaenthalpy).

name: Model.SM
summary: Molar entropy (alias entropy).

summary: Gibbs energy of mixing relative to endmembers (alias mixing_energy).

summary: Enthalpy of mixing (alias mixing_enthalpy).

name: Model.SM_MIX
summary: Entropy of mixing (alias mixing_entropy).

name: Model.CPM_MIX
summary: Heat capacity of mixing (alias mixing_heat_capacity).

summary: Degree of ordering (0 disordered .. 1), property 'DOO(PHASE)'.

summary: Curie temperature, Bohr magneton number (BMAG), Neel temperature of the phase (symbolic).

name: Model.VM

summary: Dict of energy contributions: ref, idmix, xsmix, mag, 2st, ein, vol, ord (each a symbolic expression).

summary: Full symbolic Gibbs-energy expression (SymEngine).
